sources.supports: OpenAI's o1 model documentation lists cached input at $7.5 per million tokens.
OpenAI's pricing table lists o1 input at $15, cached input at $7.50, and output at $60 per million tokens.

notes: OpenAI's official o1 documentation and pricing table give the same $15/$7.50/$60 rates, which indicates the absent cache_read value in the earlier models.dev record was an omission rather than an official price change. The available official pages are current copies and do not date when this cache rate was first applicable, so no effective date or historical bracket can be assigned.
